key_insight: A planner-executor multimodal AI agent can answer many patient questions about lung cancer screening CT while knowing when to defer out-of-scope questions to a doctor.
clinical_relevance: This could improve patient understanding and communication after lung cancer screening, supporting follow-up adherence without replacing clinician judgment.
method: Built a two-agent system: a planner to decide what to do and an executor to call imaging/tools.
Generated 699 simulated patient questions from 116 CT reports and images, split into answerable vs defer-to-doctor cases.
Evaluated tool-calling, self-regulation, and response quality with physician review and LLM-based judging.
evidence_signal: The system achieved 93.1% tool-calling accuracy and 92.6% self-regulation accuracy, with strong physician-rated clinical accuracy and understandability on sampled responses.
watch_item: Results were based on retrospective cases and simulated questions, so real-world performance, safety, and workflow fit still need prospective validation.
paper_title: Planner-Executor Style Multimodal Agentic System to Answer Patient Questions in Lung Cancer Screening CT
